patches.stem: Levothyroxine starting doses: 55-year-old with OA; 72-year-old with hypertension; 28-year-old with asthma; 46-year-old healthy female. Which starting dose strategy is appropriate?
options: Use full calculated dose for younger patients without cardiovascular disease; start low (~25 mcg) in the 72-year-old with HTN/CVD risk
Start all patients at 200 mcg regardless of age
Withhold levothyroxine in asthma until pulmonary clearance
Use the same 112 mcg start dose for every patient
patches.explanation: Healthy younger adults can start near full weight-based dose. Older adults with cardiovascular disease start low and titrate slowly.

patches.stem: Fatigue, weight loss, hyperpigmentation, postural hypotension — name the condition:
options: Primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison disease)
Cushing syndrome from adrenal tumor
Asymptomatic hyperparathyroidism
Iatrogenic Cushing from chronic prednisone
patches.explanation: Hyperpigmentation + hypotension + weight loss = adrenal insufficiency.
